checkpoint_rule.description: 1-SE (online): B = best avg_robustness_index so far; STOP at the first checkpoint (index >= 2) with R_t - B <= SE; RETURN the EARLIEST checkpoint with RI >= B - SE.
checkpoint_rule.se_source: per-checkpoint bootstrap SE from ri_curve.json (robustness_index-std/robustness_index_se/ri_se) where present, otherwise the operator-supplied --ri-se
checkpoint_rule.se_unmeasured_note: PathoROB's bootstrap fields are absent from every checkpoint in this corpus: src/spectra/eval/pathorob_adapter.py:161 defaults bootstrap=False and no caller sets it, and scripts/eval_checkpoints.RESULT_KEYS does not copy the fields into ri_curve.json.  Until one of those changes, --ri-se is the ONLY way to run this rule, and it is an operator input, not a measurement.

thunder_cls_roster.why: Reference average THUNDER classification over 16 datasets (the THUNDER paper's 12 + the 4 SPIDER organ subsets, which postdate that paper). Averaging over 12 while comparing to their 16-set figures is a roster mismatch that biases every pct_of_reference numerator.
thunder_cls_roster.seed_floor_caveat: THUNDER_FLOOR / THUNDER_SEED_SD were measured on the 12-dataset task mean (n=5 seeds).  A 16-dataset mean is LESS noisy, so reusing the 12ds SD OVER-states the error bar -- the safe direction.  No 5-seed SPIDER cohort exists to remeasure with, so it is reused, not rescaled.
thunder_cls_roster.segmentation: still 0/4 -- no SPIDER segmentation task exists and the two segpath cells are not run on this cohort.  'THUNDER' in this report means CLASSIFICATION ONLY.

thunder_base_gap_validation.reference_source: arXiv:2607.22861v1 Table 2 (THUNDER benchmark), verified 2026-08-24, read from docs/reference_published.json

criterion.cap_is_presentation_only: F-C (2026-08-26): the 100 cap no longer enters ANY arithmetic.  The >=70 per-cell test, the benchmark means, the overall average and the worst-cell search all run on the UNCAPPED pct_of_reference.  pct_capped is printed beside it so the old convention stays legible.
criterion.graded_quantity: pct_of_reference, UNCAPPED, identical for the >=70 test and for every average

stopping_rule: 1-SE on avg_robustness_index (earliest checkpoint within one SE of the best seen so far)

sources.reference_thunder: arXiv:2607.22861v1 Table 2 (THUNDER benchmark), verified 2026-08-24, read from docs/reference_published.json
sources.thunder_floors: docs/thunder_seed_floor_12ds.md, offset-2SE, 12/12 coverage; phikon/midnight/virchow2 n=5 training seeds (old corpus), hoptimus/uni2 n=2 (single c3s seed pair, pathfm-full-evals corpus)
sources.hest_seed_sd: docs/hest_seed_sd.json (estimator: pooled WITHIN-RECIPE-FAMILY across-seed SD of the HEST scalar, sqrt(sum_f df_f * sd_f^2 / sum_f df_f), df_f = n_f - 1)
sources.ri_reference: docs/reference_published.json (arXiv:2607.22861v1 Tables 1/2/3, verified 2026-08-24) -> models[<ft row>].ri.avg (Reference Table 1)
sources.hest_reference: docs/reference_published.json (arXiv:2607.22861v1 Tables 1/2/3, verified 2026-08-24) -> models[<ft row>].hest_avg (Reference Table 1 HEST column)
sources.aggregation: eval_common.pool_cells -- RATIO OF MEANS: aggregate the numerator (our raw delta) and the denominator (Reference's raw gain) over the group, then divide ONCE.  Per-cell percentages are never averaged.  Applied at both levels: 3 tasks -> backbone/THUNDER, 3 backbones -> benchmark.
sources.pooling_completeness: all-or-nothing: a pooled number requires EVERY cell of its group; a subset is withheld
sources.denominator_gate: eval_common.pooled_denominator_unresolvable, applied to the POOLED denominator (not per cell): |pooled reference gain| > 2 * SD(pooled reference gain) -- the denominator's sign/scale must be determined for the ratio to be a measurement
sources.denominator_gate_change_2026_08_26: F-P: the per-cell 'one seed-SD > 10 pct_of_reference points' veto is RETIRED as a gate and kept as a diagnostic. It was a PRECISION test (is Reference's gain known to better than +/-20% relative), not the is-the-denominator-real test its own docstring described, and it rejected cells whose denominators are unambiguously real -- phikon/knn's Reference gain is 5.8 seed-SD. Denominator imprecision is now PROPAGATED into the interval (delta method on both terms) instead of vetoing the cell.
sources.ci_construction: per-cell: eval_common.ci95 -- max(empirical 2*SD/sqrt(n), measured seed floor 2*SD/sqrt(n)).  Pooled: eval_common.pool_cells delta method, SE_agg = sqrt(sum SE_cell^2)/k on the numerator and the same on the denominator, carried onto the ratio.
